title: What do I edit?
note: Owner-facing edit-routing registry. Routes people to the canonical owner of a fact or capability; it does not grant write permission.

routes.question: Project name, location, lifecycle/status, coordinates or public project attributes
routes.rule: Edit the project-master row only. Do not fix this fact in HTML or a downstream Sheet.

routes.question: Today's work, readiness, blocker, material observation or current site status
routes.rule: Admit only evidence-backed current state; keep unsupported facts UNKNOWN/NEEDS_INPUT/HOLD.

routes.question: Historical Daily Ops or governance event
routes.rule: Append a new event. Never rewrite old history just to simplify the present.

routes.question: Project ↔ engineering file relationship
routes.rule: Drive owns the file bytes; this registry owns the normalized project-to-resource relationship.

routes.question: PDF, DWG, ETABS, photo, source file or other real engineering document
routes.rule: Keep the source file in Drive and respect its permission boundary.

routes.question: Human review/entry in Fishtail or Rohini operational Sheets
routes.rule: Use only the designated Sheet/tab. Do not make the Sheet an independent project-master truth store.

routes.question: Field clarification, tracker reply or concise follow-up
routes.rule: Ask only for unresolved facts; evidence must be reconciled before it becomes canonical truth.

routes.question: Schedule, activity sequence, calendars, resources, productivity, Primavera/open-source planning
routes.owner: JP Scheduling Work and Resources Management
routes.rule: Scheduling logic belongs in the specialist module, not Daily Ops JSON.

routes.question: BOQ, estimate, quantities, rates or cost calculations
routes.rule: Cost-engine logic belongs in the cost module.

routes.question: Structural model, analysis, OpenSees, verification or structural analysis report
routes.rule: Research may link to the engine, but production structural computation belongs here.

routes.question: CAD drawing production or drawing publication
routes.rule: Approved/current project drawing links may flow back to project resources.

routes.question: AEC/Structural research, hydropower research, methodology or research evidence
routes.rule: Research dissemination belongs in R&D; executable specialist engines remain separate.

routes.question: Academic study notes, learning materials or study workflows
routes.rule: Keep learning content separate from production project operations.
